label: Housing bond purchase rate on a property transfer
unit: per 1,000 of the published assessed value
appliesTo: Registration of ownership transfer or preservation for housing. Land and other property run on separate schedules.
why: Six bands, and outside the lowest one the rate also splits by region — so the same home costs a different bond obligation in Seoul than elsewhere. It is calculated on the published assessed value, not on the price paid, and the band is set by each buyer's share where a property is bought jointly.

history.source: Housing and Urban Fund Act Enforcement Decree, via the 2026 National Housing Bond practice manual
